notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
When the Triskelavite dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Triskelavite using its own ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
